limitations: Review is of a virtual proposal; root must pin these seven output hashes before apply, then verify all final source files and the generated merge state.
Actual-body simulation proves callback code behavior under spies, not Android Binder retention or six-hour time-limit enforcement.
Full app compile/lint/test receipts and original-certificate signing are separate gates.
Injected stopForeground exception still propagates after stopSelf; no blanket recovery guarantee is asserted.
No real device installation, YouTube Music processing, sound continuity, or foreground-service policy eligibility was certified.
